title: Core 2D drafting workflow on the verified CAD/BIM foundation
objective: Deliver a real, usable 2D drafting workflow on the verified shared CAD/BIM application shell, OCCT geometry adapter, persistent model/revision/Construction Graph bridge and engine-independent semantics: a 2D document/drafting workspace (canvas viewport, persistent layers, visibility/selection state, grid + snap configuration, coordinate entry/display, pan/zoom + persisted view), core drafting entities (line/polyline, circle/arc, rectangle, basic dimensions, entity properties + layer assignment), precision and snapping with declared tolerances and no silent approximation, editing (select/move/copy/delete, trim/extend where supported, property edits, undo/redo through the existing document command model, revision creation through the existing immutable history), persistence and downstream identity (save/open preserves entities, layers, ids, provenance and revision lineage; the Construction Graph bridge keeps using canonical editor/domain ids), with Web/Electron parity through the shared App API.
acceptance_criteria: Representative 2D drafting benchmark can be created, edited, saved, reopened and versioned in Web and Electron.
Coordinate/precision behavior has deterministic numerical assertions with declared tolerances.
Layer visibility and entity selection persist through save/open.
At least one snap workflow is automated and deterministic.
Undo/redo and immutable revision history are exercised by tests.
No renderer/application direct imports of OCCT/FreeCAD/IfcOpenShell.
Construction Graph identity remains independent of engine GlobalIds.
Web and Electron produce equivalent semantic document/revision results.
CI reproduces the drafting tests and both host builds.
Existing CAD/BIM regression and feasibility evidence remains green.
No protected architecture paths are modified.
non_goals: No advanced parametric constraint solver beyond the bounded drafting scope (dimensions measure at creation; no live re-computation).
No Project/scheduling implementation or research (explicitly deferred by the Architect).
No architecture modification (Architecture v1.1 stays frozen).
No approval or verification claim by implementation.
risk_assumptions: Issue #37 + directive comment 5430189102 are the authoritative scope; the spec/work-items.md roadmap line for COMPAT-CAD-001 is a shorter summary (benchmark thresholds) — divergence flagged, not silently reconciled.

The layer table is versioned document STRUCTURE edited through the DocumentEdit command model (addLayer/updateLayer/removeLayer as additive edit types), but revision content hashes and replay verification remain ELEMENT-based: this preserves byte-compatibility with every recorded history from CAD-IMPLEMENT-003 and RESEARCH-CAD-007 (zero risk to existing evidence) at the cost of layer-table lineage living in the recorded applied edits rather than in the content hash; the layer counter next_layer_sequence is persisted on the history so ly- identities are never reused.

Entity selection persistence through save/open supersedes the legacy 'open clears selection' behavior per the Issue #37 acceptance criteria; the legacy behavior applies only to snapshots without a persisted selection.

The parity content hash now covers persisted workspace content only (version, format/lineage, elements, layers, drafting settings); model history, selection and ephemeral editor state (undo flags) are excluded by design — existing histories and event streams are unaffected.

2D drafting is engine-free by design: drafting entities carry engineId null and the drafting core is pure TypeScript inside the LOCK-018-scanned protected set; the OCCT adapter boundary is untouched and governs 3D solids exactly as before.

Trim/extend support line targets only (the declared supported set for this slice); trim/extend on other entity types fail with a typed drafting_unsupported error, and boundary-less picks return honest no-op reasons.

Dimensions store measured values computed deterministically at creation (aligned/horizontal/vertical modes; radius from the referenced entity); they do not live-update (parametric constraints are an explicit non-goal).
CAD-IMPLEMENT-001/002 remain at PR_OPEN (existing governance debt, untouched); PR #30 remains open and unmodified.
Architecture v1.1 is active and frozen.

evidence.description: 190/190 app tests with the real OCCT toolchain locally (139 existing CAD/BIM tests stay green + 51 new deterministic drafting tests: entities 12, geom2d 10, snap 12, editops 12, workflow 3, host-parity 2), including declared-tolerance coordinate assertions, deterministic snap ranking, trim/extend exact coordinates, revision/replay verification and Web/Electron host parity through the real transports.

Deployable host proofs: the Web host lint/typecheck/build clean and a live dev-server HTTP smoke drives the full drafting workflow (layers, 6 entity types, dimensions, snap, move/copy/delete, trim/extend exact coordinates, undo/redo, save/open with identical graph events hash); the Electron host build + typecheck clean and the new --smoke-drafting BrowserWindow smoke passes 13/13 steps engine-free, with the smoke + smoke:model regressions green.

transitions.reason: Issue #37 opened with the COMPAT-CAD-001 scope; Architecture v1.1 stays frozen, Construction Graph stays canonical, geometry stays behind the frozen adapter boundary, Web/Electron share the same contracts.

Architect execution directive (comment 5430189102): branch work/compat-cad-001-2d-drafting created from the verified main line; implement the 2D drafting milestone only; Project/scheduling stays deferred.
2D drafting implementation started on the assigned branch (core contracts → document/history extension → drafting core → App API → hosts → CI).

evidence_requirements: Deterministic drafting tests with declared tolerances.
Web and Electron host parity through the shared App API.
Adapter isolation (no engine imports in renderer/application/drafting core).
Construction Graph identity independent of engine GlobalIds.
CI reproducing the drafting tests and both host builds.
Existing CAD/BIM regression and feasibility evidence staying green.
